status: Shared visual foundations implemented across official apps. Workflow and accessibility evidence remains scoped to the recorded checks; this is not a blanket certification.

waves.title: 01 · Shared foundations
waves.scope: SDK, logos, tokens, sign-in, app switcher
waves.job: One recognizable, accessible journey across the stack.
waves.checks: Verify shared palette, controls, suite mark, focus, sign-in, direct/deep-link handoff and role boundaries. Retain real IdP and assistive-technology checks as separate evidence.
waves.evidence: See reviews/2026-09-22-suite-standard.md for the cross-suite visual adoption, regression checks and remaining manual certification boundaries.

waves.title: 02 · Hub & operations
waves.scope: Hub, Kitchen, Vault, Cloud Engine console
waves.job: Understand access, automate work and operate the suite with confidence.
waves.checks: People → effective permissions → app confirmation; sync provenance; updates and partial recovery; snapshot/restore consequences; TV pairing, expiry and aggregate scope.
waves.evidence: See reviews/2026-09-22-suite-standard.md for the cross-suite visual adoption, regression checks and remaining manual certification boundaries.

waves.title: 03 · Everyday work
waves.job: Resolve requests and equipment work without duplicate entry.
waves.checks: Employee/agent/admin journeys; customer project boundaries; offboarding with inactive people; device return and external sale; next-action blockers and actual physical handover.
waves.evidence: See reviews/2026-09-22-suite-standard.md for the cross-suite visual adoption, regression checks and remaining manual certification boundaries.

waves.title: 04 · Response & reporting
waves.scope: Desk on-call, customer support, status, HR/Finance
waves.job: Coordinate incidents, schedules and defensible reporting.
waves.checks: Coverage, DST and swaps; acknowledgment vs delivery; customer/public audience previews; project scope; time review, compensation, release and export boundaries.
waves.evidence: See reviews/2026-09-22-suite-standard.md for the cross-suite visual adoption, regression checks and remaining manual certification boundaries.

waves.title: 05 · Risk & commitments
waves.job: Understand the evidence and act before a problem becomes costly.
waves.checks: Posture score denominators and freshness; device deployment/recovery guides; unavailable DNS/certificate checks; actionable renewal deadlines and currency/report scope.
waves.evidence: See reviews/2026-09-22-suite-standard.md for the cross-suite visual adoption, regression checks and remaining manual certification boundaries.

waves.title: 06 · Build & publish
waves.scope: Forms, Crumbs, SDK/MCP, Bug, website & marketplace
waves.job: Create useful extensions and publish a credible, coherent product.
waves.checks: Form creation and guest scope; analytics empty/history states; embed guides and key scopes; AI evidence; game-specific visual exception; marketing truth; sanitized screenshots and docs.
waves.evidence: See reviews/2026-09-22-suite-standard.md for the cross-suite visual adoption, regression checks and remaining manual certification boundaries.

checklist: Name the primary role, job, next actor, blocker and completion evidence.
Test permitted and denied roles, inactive identities, direct URLs, API calls and guest/project boundaries.
Exercise loading, empty, partial, stale, forbidden, error, retry, duplicate events and interrupted writes.
Check drafts, validation, save behavior, concurrency, bulk scope and consequential-action preview.
Check canonical logos, semantic tokens, type, spacing, hierarchy, components, themes and full cross-app journey.
Keyboard, focus, semantic structure, screen reader, contrast, 200% text, 320 px reflow and reduced motion.
Verify query/count/export scope, units, currencies, timezone, data freshness and source links.
Check data minimization, secrets, retention/cleanup evidence, public updates and TV/HR projections.
Use consistent language, useful errors, translated-length labels and prerequisite → action → verify → recover guides.
Record before/after task evidence, module versions/changelogs, required tests, known gaps and deployment status.

severities.P0: Access bypass, secret exposure, destructive ambiguity or false completion of a consequential action. Blocks release.
severities.P1: Core task cannot be completed, material state is wrong, or keyboard/screen-reader users are blocked. Blocks the affected release until fixed or an explicit safe scope reduction is reviewed.
severities.P2: Avoidable friction, inconsistent hierarchy, duplicated entry or an unclear secondary state. Prioritize within the redesign wave.
severities.P3: Cosmetic polish with no material task impact. Bundle with the affected surface.
